title: Finite scalar comparisons of the normalized DVR Roos limit
statement: Fix l,E,X,D as in [def-coef-normalized-dvr-tower], a normalized DVR tower T, and an object M with a specified Roos limit triangle and projections p [def-weil-derived-limit]. For every finite index n and every tensor--restriction adjunction between the fixed functors of [lem-weil-derived-scalar-extension-restriction-adjunction], the adjoint of p followed by the n-th product projection and T.evaluationIso_n is an isomorphism in the finite-coefficient derived category.

proof.text: Restriction of module sheaves is faithful, exact and preserves the underlying additive map. If its derived image of f is invertible, its homology images are invertible by the exact-restriction homology comparison. Faithfulness reflects mono and epi on every homology map; an abelian category is balanced. Thus every homology map of f is invertible and f is invertible.

theorem normalizedDVRRoos_finite_reduction
    (T : NormalizedDVRTower l E X D hl)
    (M : completedIntegralDerivedCategory l E X D hl)
    [HasProduct (fun n : ℕ ↦ (normalizedDVRTowerEvaluation l E X D hl n).obj T.tower)]
    (p : M ⟶ ∏ᶜ fun n : ℕ ↦ (normalizedDVRTowerEvaluation l E X D hl n).obj T.tower)
    (δ : (∏ᶜ fun n : ℕ ↦ (normalizedDVRTowerEvaluation l E X D hl n).obj T.tower) ⟶
      M⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧)
    (hc : IsDerivedLimitTriangle
      (fun n : ℕ ↦ (normalizedDVRTowerTransition l E X D hl n.le_succ).app T.tower)
      M p δ) (n : ℕ)
    (adj : scalarReductionDerivedExtension l E X n ⊣
      scalarReductionDerivedRestriction l E X n) :
    IsIso ((adj.homEquiv M (T.M n)).symm
      (p ≫ Pi.π _ n ≫ (T.evaluationIso n).hom))
